title: Weapon or Weakness?
html:
Pride can take you down. As they say, pride comes before a fall.

The fall comes, not because pride exists but because you stop seeing clearly.

You start believing your own story.

You stop checking yourself. You miss the warning signs.

That’s false pride.

There is another version of pride.

One that is quiet, solid and controlled.

You know who you are. You know what you stand for. You don’t need to prove it.

The difference between the two?

One forgets you are human. The other remembers it.

You will make mistakes. You will get things wrong. You are not above the fall.

That awareness keeps you steady.

Without real self-worth, people compensate.

They talk more. They compete more. They try to win things that don’t matter.

Healthy pride doesn’t need noise.

It gives you standards. It gives you direction. It lets you respect yourself and others at the same time.

Pride is a tool.

Use it well, and it builds you and helps you grow. Use it poorly, and it exposes you.

This week’s Motivator

Stand tall. Stay grounded. Have pride in yourself and what you do.

Prompt for the week

Where do you need less ego and more awareness?
